subject: Create main pipeline (src/engine/pipeline.ts) + tests
description:
Create `src/engine/pipeline.ts` with `Pipeline` class:
- `DEFAULT_PIPELINE_CONFIG` constant
- constructor(config?, apiKey?) — merges with defaults, creates GeminiClient and OutputStore
- `generate(imagePath, scenario, promptOverride?)` — composes prompt, calls Gemini, creates metadata with renderId (date_uuid format), saves via store, returns GenerateResult
- `generateFromUrl(imageUrl, scenario, promptOverride?)` — downloads image to temp file, calls generate, cleans up temp file in finally block
- `getStore()` — returns OutputStore reference
- `formatDate(date)` — private helper for render ID formatting

Also create `src/engine/index.ts` with re-exports of all engine modules.
Create `src/index.ts` as main package export (re-exports engine, storage, config).

Create `tests/engine/pipeline.test.ts` with mocked @google/genai:
- generates output and saves metadata
- metadata contains expected fields (model, outputPath exists, observability fields)

Depends on: types.ts (Task #2), gemini-client.ts (Task #5), prompt.ts (Task #4), scenario.ts (Task #3), output-store.ts (Task #6)
